title: fix: ListView navigation modes page/new_window/split/popover non-functional on row click
body:
Only drawer/modal navigation modes worked when clicking ListView rows. The other four modes (page, new_window, split, popover) were silently no-ops due to missing wiring across multiple layers.

### Root causes & fixes

- **page mode** — Console's `onNavigate` callback only set `?recordId=` search params (overlay logic), never actually navigated. Now calls `navigate(`record/${recordId}`)` via React Router. Also wired `objectViewSchema.onNavigate` to handle `mode === 'view'`.

- **new_window** — `useNavigationOverlay` hardcoded `window.open(/${objectName}/${recordId})` which doesn't match Console routing. Hook now delegates to `onNavigate(id, 'new_window')` when available; Console builds the correct URL from `window.location.pathname`.

- **split mode** — `NavigationOverlay` requires `mainContent` prop for split rendering, but Console never passed it. Restructured JSX to conditionally render `NavigationOverlay` with `mainContent` wrapping `PluginObjectView` when split is active.

- **popover mode** — `NavigationOverlay` required a `popoverTrigger` (Radix anchor), which list contexts don't have. Added fallback: renders as compact Dialog when no trigger is provided.

- **plugin-view** — `handleRowClick` had no `split`/`popover` branches, so clicks fell through to no-op. Added both.

### Key change in `useNavigationOverlay`

```ts
// new_window now delegates to app layer when onNavigate is available
if (mode === 'new_window' || navigation.openNewTab) {
  const recordId = record._id || record.id;
  if (onNavigate && recordId != null) {
    onNavigate(recordId as string | number, 'new_window');
    return;
  }
  // fallback: generic URL
  window.open(`/${objectName}/${recordId}`, '_blank');
}
```

### Tests

+10 new tests across 4 files with click-through verification for all navigation modes. Console ObjectView integration tests simulate row clicks through a ListView mock with `onRowClick` support and verify:

- **page**: `mockNavigate('record/rec-1')` called after row click
- **new_window**: `window.open` called with URL containing `/record/rec-1` + `'_blank'` after row click
- **split**: Split detail panel with "Close panel" button renders after row click
- **popover**: Fallback dialog (role="dialog") renders after row click

Full test suite: **6,736 passed / 0 failed** (366 files, 2 skipped). ROADMAP.md updated.

> <issue_description>## 现象
> 在 ObjectUI 控制台/ListView，只有 drawer/modal 导航模式生效，设置为 page、new_window、split、popover 时点击行没有任何反应。
> 
> ---
> 
> ## 最终目标
> 所有正式支持的行导航模式（drawer、modal、page、new_window、split、popover），点击列表行后都能正确弹窗、跳转或打开新窗口，表现与规范一致。
> 
> ---
> 
> ## 详细修复点与检查清单
> 
> ### 1. page 模式无效
> - [ ] Console 的 onNavigate 回调在 mode: 'view' 时未实现，应导航到 `/apps/:appName/:objectName/record/:recordId`
> - [ ] 必须修复 onNavigate 支持 mode 为 view 时的跳转逻辑
> - [ ] 单测：page 模式点击后能正常路由到详情页
> 
> ### 2. new_window 模式无效
> - [ ] useNavigationOverlay 新窗口跳转 URL 必须符合 Console 路由 (`/apps/:appName/:objectName/record/:recordId`)，不是 `/:objectName/:recordId`
> - [ ] 或统一用 onNavigate 让应用层决定跳转方式
> - [ ] 单测：new_window 下��开新标签页能展示正确数据
> 
> ### 3. split 模式无效
> - [ ] NavigationOverlay 需要 mainContent props，Console 需提供 mainContent，且点击行时 split 能展开详情
> - [ ] PluginView 内 handleRowClick 需支持 split 并正确切换 overlay 状态
> - [ ] 单测：split 状态下能够分栏浏览详情
> 
> ### 4. popover 模式无效
> - [ ] 传递 popoverTrigger，确保点击能弹出定位正确的卡片预览
> - [ ] 单测：popover 能悬浮预览详情信息
> 
> ### 5. PluginView 代码需补充 split、popover 分支
> - [ ] handleRowClick 要有 split、popover 直接调用 overlay 控制
> - [ ] 其他层级 handleClick 需同步
> 
> ### 6. 通用 & 验收
> - [ ] 所有导航模式回归测试（自动化/手工）
> - [ ] 修复后运行所有 test，无回归/新增用例全过
> - [ ] 更新 Roadmap 文档，补充导航模式说明
